personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass/Luxe elevated surfaces
personality_one_liner: A high-octane, futuristic command center that puts game accounts in the spotlight with deep obsidian backgrounds and striking neon red accents.

spacing.rule: Use intentional spacing (md/lg) to prevent cramping while maintaining a tactical, dashboard-like feel. Avoid unnecessary empty spaces. Form elements should be tight, but content blocks should breathe.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to make it float above scrolling content.
Use frosted glass on sticky headers when scrolling in the Home or Product Detail pages.
Apply glass effects on floating action buttons (FABs) or the primary CTA fixed at the bottom.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard product cards or list rows; rely on solid surfaceSecondary.
Do not use blur behind form inputs or body text.

screens.name: Beranda
screens.purpose: Showcase featured games, trending accounts, and current promotions in an immersive layout.

states.loading: Dark skeleton loaders matching the neon-accented cards.
states.error: Failed to load the feed. Retry button with neon outline.

screens.layout: Hero banner with abstract neon red lighting at the top (with top-to-bottom gradient scrim). A horizontal scrolling 'Game Categories' shelf underneath. Below that, a 2-column grid of 'Trending Accounts' (surfaceSecondary cards) with edge-to-edge thumbnails.

screens.name: Kategori
screens.purpose: A structured grid allowing users to quickly find specific games to buy or sell accounts.
screens.layout: Grid-based layout with 2 or 3 columns. Each tile uses a game logo PNG on a brandTertiary or surfaceSecondary background. Clean, scannable, high-contrast.

screens.name: Jual Akun
screens.purpose: Streamlined, tactical form for sellers to list their game accounts for moderation and sale.

states.empty: Select a game first to start selling.
states.error: Submission failed. Highlight missing fields in red.

screens.layout: Single-column form. Labels above inputs. Use surfaceTertiary for input backgrounds to create depth against surface. Submit CTA is sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Favorit
screens.purpose: Quick access to saved game accounts users are considering.

states.empty: A stylized abstract illustration indicating no favorites saved yet. 'Start exploring to save your dream accounts.'

screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card has a thumbnail on the left, details on the right, and a neon red heart icon.

screens.name: Profil
screens.purpose: User command center for order tracking, payment management, and entry to Admin Dashboard.

states.empty: Not logged in. Show login CTA.

screens.layout: Top section features user avatar and stats (Balance, Active Listings). Middle section is a grid of quick actions (Pesanan, Pembayaran). Bottom section contains list rows for settings and the Admin Dashboard entry point.

hero_banner.alt: Abstract dark futuristic neon red lighting background

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '7 Dark-First Utility' combined with '6 Glass/Luxe' UI rules. Ensure the UI feels like a premium gaming dashboard (deep blacks #0A0A0A, metallic grays #1A1A1E, and neon red #FF003C accents).
Always format prices in Rupiah as 'Rp X.XXX.XXX'.
Use 'Rajdhani' for impactful display headers (stats, prices, section titles) and 'Manrope' for readable body text.
Do NOT use pure black with pure white text to avoid eye strain; use the defined surface/onSurface pairs.
Implement a sticky bottom primary CTA where necessary (e.g., Jual Akun submit, Checkout), hovering above scrolling content using frosted glass techniques.
Use the gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) pattern strictly over all hero and game background images before laying text on them.
For the bottom navigation, strictly implement the 5 requested tabs: Beranda, Kategori, Jual Akun, Favorit, Profil.
Web research indicates immersive horizontal scrolling shelves for games and grid-based inventory layouts. Utilize surfaceSecondary cards with 12px border radius for account listings.
If game logos are missing or fail to load, fall back to initials within a brandTertiary-tinted square, not generic icons.
